name: xdive
description: Search the web, read pages as Markdown, map and crawl sites, extract structured data, and research questions with cited sources through XDive's hosted MCP server.

interface.longDescription: XDive gives the assistant read-only access to the public web. Search the web or news and get the most relevant passages of each result; read any page as Markdown, with long pages delivered in parts; list a site's URLs or crawl it; extract structured data from up to 10 pages with a prompt or a JSON Schema; and research a question across several sources with every claim cited. You sign in with your XDive account and choose an organization; calls count toward that organization's usage like any API call, and you can revoke access at any time under API Keys, Connected apps. Every tool only reads: XDive never posts, buys, or changes anything on the sites it reads.
defaultPrompt: Research what changed in the latest Python release and cite your sources.
Search the news from the past week about electric vehicle batteries and summarize it.
Map docs.python.org and list the pages about asyncio.
